		effects = {
			COLDWAR_EC_open_click = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open }
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open
					remove_from_array = { global.cwec_viewers = THIS }
				}
				else = {
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwec_viewers value = THIS } } }
						add_to_array = { global.cwec_viewers = THIS }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_tab < 1 } }
						set_variable = { cwec_ui_tab = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwec_ui_chap = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwec_ui_mode = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwec_ui_size = 2 }
						set_variable = { cwec_ui_type = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwec_ui_ret = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwec_ui_stance = 1 }
						set_variable = { cwec_ui_proj = 101 }
					}
					COLDWAR_EC_ui_global = yes
					COLDWAR_EC_ui_refresh = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_dirty = 1 }
			}
		}
		properties = {
			COLDWAR_EC_open = { x = global.var_missiles_button_x }
		}

	COLDWAR_EC_community = {
		context_type = player_context
		window_name = "COLDWAR_EC_community_window"
		parent_scripted_gui = COLDWAR_EC_main
		dirty = global.cwec_dirty
		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		visible = { is_ai = no
			check_variable = { cwec_ui_tab = 5 } }
		effects = {
			ec_m_prev_click = {
				add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_mpage = -1 }
				COLDWAR_EC_ui_refresh = yes
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_dirty = 1 }
			}
			ec_m_next_click = {
				add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_mpage = 1 }
				COLDWAR_EC_ui_refresh = yes
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_dirty = 1 }
			}
			ec_pap_prev_click = {
				add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_papage = -1 }
				COLDWAR_EC_ui_refresh = yes
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_dirty = 1 }
			}
			ec_pap_next_click = {
				add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_papage = 1 }
				COLDWAR_EC_ui_refresh = yes
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_dirty = 1 }
			}
			ec_pa1_btn_click = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_pa1 = 1 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_schengen }
						clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_schengen
					}
					else = {
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_schengen
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_pa1 = 2 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_snake }
						clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_snake
					}
					else = {
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_snake
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_pa1 = 3 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ems }
						clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ems
					}
					else = {
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ems
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_pa1 = 4 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_emu }
						clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_emu
					}
					else = {
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_emu
						if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_emu_support_cost } set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -5 } COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_pa1 = 5 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_werner3 }
						clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_werner3
					}
					else = {
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_werner3
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_pa1 = 6 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_charter }
						clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_charter
					}
					else = {
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_charter
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_pa1 = 7 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_airbus }
						clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_airbus
					}
					else = {
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_airbus
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_pa1 = 8 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ariane }
						clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ariane
					}
					else = {
						set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ariane
					}
				}
				COLDWAR_EC_refresh_country = yes
				COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
				COLDWAR_EC_touch = yes
			}
			ec_pa2_btn_click = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_pa2 = 1 } }
					if = {

					}

					}
					else = {

					}
				}

					if = {

				}
				COLDWAR_EC_refresh_country = yes
				COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
				COLDWAR_EC_touch = yes
			}
			ec_ac_apply_click = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
				add_political_power = -50
				COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes
				COLDWAR_EC_touch = yes
			}
			ec_ac_assoc_click = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
				add_political_power = -25
				COLDWAR_EC_request_association = yes
				COLDWAR_EC_touch = yes
			}
			ec_ac_campaign_click = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
				add_political_power = -50
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.001 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = 5 }
				COLDWAR_EC_push_support = yes
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_campaign_cd days = 365 value = 1 }
				COLDWAR_EC_touch = yes
			}
			ec_ac_sceptic_click = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
				add_political_power = -25
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -5 }
				COLDWAR_EC_push_support = yes
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_campaign_cd days = 365 value = 1 }
				COLDWAR_EC_touch = yes
			}
			ec_ac_referendum_click = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
				COLDWAR_EC_referendum_result = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_yes > 49.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = 10 }
					COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
					add_stability = 0.02
				}
				else = {
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_leaving
					set_variable = { cwec_leave_on = global.num_days }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_leave_on = 365 }
				}
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_referendum_cd days = 1825 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { cwec_ev14_item = 0 }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.14 }
				COLDWAR_EC_touch = yes
			}
			ec_ac_leave_click = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
				add_stability = -0.05
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwec_members
					if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = PREV } } add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_left } }
				}
				COLDWAR_EC_leave_member = yes
				COLDWAR_EC_touch = yes
			}
		}
		triggers = {
			ec_m_prev_click_enabled = {
				check_variable = { cwec_ui_mpage > 0 }
